issues.quote: The watch has run badly for ten years. I have never let anyone regulate it
issues.fact: F1 gives only one reading: at the bell's nine, the watch showed twenty to nine. The sheet says nothing about the watch's rate or whether its error is constant.
issues.misreading: 'Run badly' suggests an erratic or drifting error, so a solver could conclude the watch's offset is unknown or changes over time and discard the watch-based times. The sheet supports a single fixed 20-minute offset at most.

issues.quote: My father's watch, which is wrong, and my uncle, who laughed at it.
issues.fact: The sheet says only that the watch showed twenty minutes to nine when the bell struck nine. It does not say the watch is wrong in general or give any other reading of its accuracy.
issues.misreading: Calling the watch simply 'wrong' invites a solver to doubt every watch reading in the statement, not just to correct for the offset the dinner reading gives.

issues.quote: I thought it was him, working late, as he always does.
issues.fact: The sheet gives only the sound from the atelier at 10:18 and the uncle's repeater. It does not say the uncle was working in the atelier or was alive and active at that time.
issues.misreading: The line places the uncle in the atelier, working late, during the 10:15 to 10:21 window, which is a whereabouts hint the sheet does not provide.

issues.quote: The heir, alone in the library, directly under the bench where he was found.
issues.fact: The sheet says only that Monnier went to the library and stayed there alone after dinner. It gives no inheritance, no bench, and no finding of a body.
issues.misreading: 'The heir' and 'where he was found' add a motive and a location for the victim that the solver is not given, and they could shift how the library's occupancy is weighed.

issues.quote: they quarrelled about the price at dinner. I think Girard also wanted to talk about my debts
issues.fact: The sheet says only that Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 and sat with Monnier until eleven. It gives no quarrel and no debt discussion.
issues.misreading: A quarrel at dinner and a debt motive add a hint about Girard's relations with the uncle and his whereabouts that the sheet does not state.

issues.quote: Then his repeater sounded. ... At a quarter past ten by my watch, someone went quickly up the stairs
issues.fact: The stairs event was at 10:15, before the 10:18 thump and the repeater. The sheet gives the explicit clock times for each event.
issues.misreading: The narration puts the stairs after the repeater, so a solver reading the order of the speech could take the stairs as coming after the repeater. The explicit times resolve this, so it is only awkward.
